Workflows.title: Display the checking account transaction table from the home splash screen
Workflows.goal: The splash page loads and GET STARTED NOW button is visible; The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and the dashboard begins loading; The dashboard is fully rendered and the welcome dialog is closed; The CHECKING ACCOUNT ACTIVITY card and its AVAILABLE BALANCE label are present; The browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking; The Account Activity heading and at least one data row are visible; H2 reads 'Account Activity' and URL contains /account?type=checking; Columns are ['Id', 'Date', 'Description', 'Amount', 'Balance', 'Actions']; rowCount is greater than 0; Pagination text matches pattern \d+ – \d+ of \d+; SELECT ACCOUNT label and Checking button are visible
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the home splash screen — The splash page loads and GET STARTED NOW button is visible
2. Click GET STARTED NOW to launch the simulator — The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and the dashboard begins loading
3. Wait for the dashboard and dismiss the welcome dialog if it appears — The dashboard is fully rendered and the welcome dialog is closed
4. Verify the Checking Account Activity card and AVAILABLE BALANCE label are visible — The CHECKING ACCOUNT ACTIVITY card and its AVAILABLE BALANCE label are present
5. Click VIEW ACCOUNT on the Checking Account Activity card — The browser navigates to /bank-sim/account?type=checking
6. Wait for the Account Activity page to display the transaction table — The Account Activity heading and at least one data row are visible
7. Assert the heading and URL are correct for the checking account page — H2 reads 'Account Activity' and URL contains /account?type=checking
8. Verify the transaction table has the expected six column headers — Columns are ['Id', 'Date', 'Description', 'Amount', 'Balance', 'Actions']
9. Verify at least one transaction row is present — rowCount is greater than 0
10. Verify the pagination label shows row counts — Pagination text matches pattern \d+ – \d+ of \d+
11. Verify the SELECT ACCOUNT label and Checking toggle are visible — SELECT ACCOUNT label and Checking button are visible
